impacted_locations.name: Banten
impacted_locations.source_title: Berita | Portal Layanan Satu Pintu Badan Geologi
impacted_locations.evidence: dalam pada wilayah Kabupaten Lampung Selatan, Provinsi Lampung. Meskipun demikian, pengamatan Gunungapi Anak Krakatau dilakukan melalui 2 pos pengamatan gunungapi, yaitu Pos Pengamatan Gunungapi Anak Krakatau di Kalianda, Kabupaten Lampung Selatan, Provinsi Lampung, dan Pos Pengamatan Gunungapi Anak Krakatau di Pasauran, Kabupaten Serang, Provinsi Banten. Berdasarkan gejala peningkatan kegempaan vulkanik dan deformasi, Gunungapi Anak Krakatau statusnya dinaikan menjadi Siaga (Level III) sejak 2

impacted_locations.name: Bengkulu
impacted_locations.evidence: 4 jam terhadap perkembangan aktivitas erupsi Gunung Anak Krakatau (GAK) dan dampaknya terhadap atmosfer, penerbangan, serta kondisi laut di sekitar Selat Sunda. Berdasarkan analisis citra satelit pada Minggu (6/9) pukul 08.00 WIB, BMKG mengidentifikasi dua klaster sebaran abu vulkanik yang melingkupi wilayah Banten, DKI Jakarta, Jawa Barat, hingga Bengkulu. impacted_locations.name: Singapore
impacted_locations.source_title: Malaysia Airlines cancels 12 Jakarta flights after Anak Krakatau eruption | The Star
impacted_locations.evidence: porarily closed on Sunday after volcanic ash from the eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau was detected in the airport area, disrupting 209 flights and affecting 22,798 passengers. Civil Aviation Director General Lukman F Laisa said 16 international flights were cancelled, seven delayed and five rescheduled, involving services to and from Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Hong Kong, Sydney, Seoul/Incheon, Doha and Amsterdam. regional_impacts.indonesia_description: BMKG identified volcanic-ash clusters affecting parts of Banten, DKI Jakarta, Jawa Barat, Lampung and Bengkulu, with higher-level ash extending farther west and southwest over the Indian Ocean.

singapore.description: Singapore Airlines reported Singapore–Jakarta flight disruption associated with the Anak Krakatau eruption.
